follow-up time: Not specified, mentioned as the mean follow-up period
exposure: uterine artery embolisation (UAE) for bleeding after dilatation and curettage (D&C)
cohort: 11 patients who underwent UAE for bleeding after dilatation and curettage (D&C) performed for abortion or termination
finding: Uterine artery embolisation (UAE) was found to be a safe and effective treatment option for bleeding after dilatation and curettage (D&C), particularly for women who wish to preserve their fertility.
